# FemNEST

> FemNEST is the first platform mapping 50+ female health and life transitions, from fertility to menopause, to their real financial outcomes, so individuals, employers, and partners can act on what matters most, instead of guessing.

FemNEST is a pre-seed femtech/fintech company founded by Serena Gasparini in Cyprus in 2025. It is community-first: a live waitlist of 130+ women, a sold-out launch event (February 2026, Paphos), and a second flagship event, Femmes, Finances & Freedom (13 February 2027, Paphos), precede the MVP launch planned for Spring 2027.

The company works with three audiences: individuals navigating their own health and life transitions, employers building a structured pilot to get ahead of the EU Pay Transparency Directive (compliance deadline June 2027), and partners/investors backing the platform pre-seed.

- [Community](https://www.yourfemnest.com/events.html): FemNEST's in-person events, including Femmes, Finances & Freedom.
- [Femmes, Finances & Freedom](https://www.yourfemnest.com/event-femmes-finances-freedom.html): FemNEST's flagship event, 13 February 2027 in Paphos, Cyprus — agenda, tickets, sponsorship, and speaker applications.
- [Invest](https://www.yourfemnest.com/investors.html): FemNEST's pitch to investors — market opportunity, traction, and how to request the deck.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- FemNEST is not yet a live consumer product; the MVP is planned for Spring 2027. Community and events are live now.
- Statistics cited on the site (pay gap, pension gap, caregiving gap) are sourced from EIGE, Eurostat, the WEF Global Gender Gap Report, and the World Bank Global Findex — see the relevant page for the specific source of each figure.
- The company's registered legal entity is M. S. Project Zeus CY LTD, trading as FemNEST, registered in Pafos, Cyprus.
- Media/partnership contact: hello@yourfemnest.com.
